title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Critics Academy x NYFF Shorts #1
excerpt_original: Participants in this year’s Film at Lincoln Center Critics Academy discuss shorts by Peggy Ahwesh, Adam Piron, and Kevin Jerome Everson

blocks.text: This week and next, we’re handing over The Film Comment Podcast to the participants of the 2026 Film at Lincoln Center Critics Academy —an annual program for up-and-coming critics held during the New York Film Festival, led by Film Comment editors.

For this week’s episode, four of this year’s critics—Yezen Saadah, Kathy Ou, Samuel Brodsky, and Rebecca Turner — discuss some of their highlights from the shorts screening as part of NYFF’s Currents Program 5: The Material Ghost , including Peggy Ahwesh’s The Wayfinders , Adam Piron’s The Flesh of the Mountain , and Kevin Jerome Everson’s National Seating .
